newsitem.title: UK: Algeria's Sonatrach plans Senegal drilling -OPECNA.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's Sonatrach plans Senegal drilling -OPECNA.

text.p: Algerian state oil company Sonatrach plans to explore for oil in the West African state of Senegal, the OPEC News Agency (OPECNA) said on Monday.
Sonatrach was close to signing an exploration agreement with Senagal's state company PETROSEN, OPECNA said, citing sources close to Sonatrach.
OPECNA said PETROSEN's general manager was expected to arrive in Algeria in the next few days.

A statement issued at the end of the last meeting of the Algerian-Senegalese joint commission noted the recent discovery of gas deposits in Senegal and the possibility of finding oil had led Petrosen to invite Sontrach to be a partner, OPECNA said.
PETROSEN said last month it had discovered natural gas reserves estimated at 10 billion cubic metres in the region of Thies, 70 kilometres (45 miles) from the capital Dakar.
A PETROSEN official said the discovery would meet Senegal's natural gas needs for 30 years.
